capacityDefinition: Highest correctly sustained offered rate without a persistently growing queue; latency reported separately.
stopRules: Exactly four sequential runs, no injected faults, no adaptive rate search or extra repetitions.
Stop for invalid evidence, controller/cleanup failure, failed correctness checks, missing terminal callbacks, pending or failed transfers, or generator limitation.
Record queue evolution and latency without deriving capacity or automatically progressing to capacity search.
Pause only after a complete matched pair, with cleanup and approved-container restoration verified.
After four runs, stop for calibration review. No numerical overload criterion or confirmatory protocol is frozen here.
